name: Should I choose a motion-activated or always-on bathroom night light?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a motion-activated or always-on bathroom night light?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between motion-activated and always-on night lights depends on your specific needs. Motion-activated lights conserve energy and are ideal for quick, occasional nighttime visits, providing light only when needed. Always-on lights offer continuous, ambient illumination, which can be beneficial for small children or those who prefer a constant soft glow throughout the night. Consider factors like energy efficiency, frequency of use, and personal preference for consistent versus intermittent light when making your decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Motion-activated lights save energy and are good for occasional use, while always-on lights provide continuous ambient light for constant glow preferences.
